title: Less Is More
author: Felix_M._962232
desc:
Building Muscle/Strength by restricting the program to only 12 exercises, but therefore incresing the frequency of each exercise and muscle group, that get's worked out.

The focus is set on Chest, Back, Legs and Lateral Delts.

Muscles like Biceps, Triceps, Calves and Front & Rear Delts do not get their own exercises, but rely on activation during the other exercises.

Sets / Muscle Group / Week:
▪︎ 15x Chest
▪︎ 15x Back
▪︎ 15x Legs
▪︎   9x Side Delt

ex.note:
Push your butt out, hinge only at the hips!
Keep your knees bent and engage the core!

Keep your elbows slightly bent!
Pull your shoulderblades back and down and squeeze your pecks!
Hinge at the shoulder joint, not at the elbow!

Engage your lats and try to fold the bar in half!
Grip the bar at 1.5 - 2x your shoulder width!
Pull the bar slightly below your chin and not further!
Start each rep from as big of a stretch as you can manage!

Pull your shoulderblades back and down!
Keep your forearms upright with the wrist stacked ontop of it!
Hinge only at the shoulder joint.
Squeeze your pecs!

Keep your forearms in line with the rope!
Pull your elbows back and out!

Space your grip at 2x shoulder width!
Tension your core, so you don't lose energy and stay stiff in the hip!
